summary: Master the art of brand management with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights and skills to strategically position and grow your brand.
lede: Strategic brand management helps professionals responsible for brand direction make evidence-based decisions about positioning, portfolios, and customer experience. The course is for brand managers, strategists, and marketing and portfolio professionals who need to assess brand equity, define differentiated positioning, and structure brand relationships. Practical exercises use audits, perceptual maps, and scorecards to connect brand identity with customer experience and track performance.
audienceIntro: This strategic brand management course suits intermediate to advanced professionals who shape brand direction, customer meaning, portfolio choices, or brand governance. It is designed for roles that must connect market evidence with practical brand decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working experience in marketing, brand management, communications, customer experience, product marketing, or a related commercial function. Familiarity with customer research, campaign performance reports, or portfolio decisions will help, but formal certification is not required. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as brand valuation, AI-assisted insight analysis, and automated governance are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application level, while positioning, equity measurement, architecture, and governance outputs receive hands-on practice.
